_readme: Source signatures for live + retroactive identification. Data, not code, so it
is diffable and testable offline. Loaded by sources.py; scored against the
live 30 s ring and (later) against archive windows.
Every signature is EPOCH-STAMPED. Everything we measure depends on the
acquisition configuration, and this station has already had three epochs in a
week -- a signature with no valid_from will be quietly wrong the first time the
front end is touched. sources.py refuses to apply one outside its epoch.
status: 'provisional' until the activity has been observed on >= 2 SEPARATE
days. Provisional signatures are shown with a hedge in the UI. Thresholds are
deliberately set for RECALL, not precision: false positives are currently cheap

The evidence block is the receipts. Keep it honest -- a year from now it is the only way to know that garage-appliance-20hz rests on a single afternoon, and that it started life as a washer detector until the dryer proved it wasn't one.

signatures.label: mount resonance excited
signatures.hint: something is shaking the floor — washer, dryer and A/C all confirmed doing it

evidence.measured: peak 19.885-20.007 Hz regardless of source (0.6% spread); second mode 40.67-41.19 Hz, ratio 2.03-2.07. Amplitude varies with excitation, frequency does not.
notes: RETRACTED 2026-07-26: the '~1195 RPM shaft rate' reading was WRONG. At 0.012 Hz
resolution the peak sits at 19.885-20.007 Hz across washer spin, dryer, dead quiet,
midday and afternoon -- a 0.6% spread. A spin cycle ramping through speeds would sweep
far more. And the 41 Hz peak is 2.03-2.07x it in EVERY case. Fixed frequency + a 2:1
mode pair = a structural resonance of the mount/floor, which the appliances EXCITE.

PRIME SUSPECT: the geophone does not sit on the slab. The garage has inherited plastic
interlocking tile, which is compliant and hollow -- exactly the panel geometry that
resonates in the tens of Hz with a harmonic pair. See STATUS.md.

duty_cycle.note: Excitation tracks HOUSEHOLD ACTIVITY, not laundry. Measured 2026-07-26/27 on 30 s windows sampled each minute:
duty_cycle.conclusion: Excitation went UP after the dryer stopped and runs 58-79% through the whole afternoon/evening against 2% overnight. The pill currently reads 'Laundry suspected', which over-claims the same way the '1195 RPM shaft rate' did. 'Household activity' is what the data supports. The 2% overnight also shows the rule is not simply firing on noise.

confirmed_sources.note: Charles-confirmed sources that excite the 19.95 Hz mount resonance
confirmed_sources.why the pill was renamed: It read 'Laundry suspected' and Charles caught it twice: once with only the dryer running long after the washer stopped, once with ONLY the A/C running. Three appliances plus human activity all ring the same resonance, and excitation runs 58-79% of the afternoon/evening vs 2% overnight. 'Household activity' is what the data supports.
confirmed_sources.mode ratio as a fingerprint: Separates the WASHER (0.12-0.27) from everything else (1.0-1.5) with a wide clean gap, but does NOT separate dryer / A-C / cans from each other. Probably reflects the drive spectrum -- a source concentrated near 20 Hz excites mode 1 selectively; broadband sources ring both. Partial fingerprint.

standing_lines.note: FIXED resonance, not instrumental and not a machine. Same frequency in dead quiet as under a washer spin; only the amplitude changes. Suspect the plastic floor tile under the station.
second mode of the 19.95 Hz resonance -- ratio measured at 2.03-2.07 in every window tested.
